segments.name: Sugar, Ethanol and Energy
segments.description: Cultivates sugarcane in Brazil and processes it in its own mills into sugar, ethanol, electricity and biomethane for sale.
segments.evidence: Our Sugar, Ethanol and Energy line of business, as well as our Fertilizers line of business are also a reportable operating segment.

segments.name: Fertilizers
segments.description: Produces and sells fertilizers, mainly granular urea, and ammonia, supporting agricultural productivity in Argentina and South America.
segments.evidence: The "Fertilizers" segment consists of the production and commercialization of fertilizers, mainly granular urea

segments.name: Crops
segments.description: Plants, harvests and sells grains, oilseeds and fibers, and provides grain warehousing, conditioning, handling and drying services to third parties.
segments.evidence: Our Farming business is comprised of three reportable operating segments: Crops, Rice and Diary Segments.

segments.name: Rice
segments.description: Processes rough rice and sells white rice and branded rice products to consumers and export clients.
segments.evidence: We are also a large processor and exporter of white rice (processed) in Argentina and Uruguay.

segments.name: Dairy
segments.description: Operates dairy farms and processing facilities, selling milk, cheese and branded dairy products to retail consumers.
segments.evidence: We are a leading retailer of dairy products, including three popular brands

revenueModel.text: Third-party clients and industrial customers pay the company for crops, sugar, ethanol, energy, rice, dairy products and fertilizers.
revenueModel.evidence: In agriculture, we produce a diversified portfolio of products—including various crops, rice, sugarcane and dairy—supplying both our own industrial operations and third-party clients.

changes.text: In 2025 the company added a Fertilizers reportable segment after acquiring Profertil.
changes.evidence: As a result, the Company now operates three reportable segments: (i) Sugar, Ethanol and Energy, (ii) Fertilizers and (iii) Farming.
